name: noibu
description: Analyze ecommerce conversion, shopper behavior, errors, and experiments using Noibu data.

interface.longDescription: Built for ecommerce, the Noibu plugin bridges the gap between customer experience and revenue by connecting ChatGPT directly to your store's session, error, and conversion data through Noibu — and to the marketing, support, and commerce platforms that put insight into motion. Go beyond analysis: surface what's costing you revenue, take action across your stack, build workflows to automate work end-to-end.
defaultPrompt: How is my store doing in the last 24 hours?
Compare checkout performance with the previous 30 days.
Find evidence-backed A/B tests to improve add-to-cart rate.

positive.description: Store health and cumulative purchase funnel for carsncards.com, October 15–21, 2026 UTC. Precondition: dedicated reviewer account can access this store and retained ecommerce data. Revenue may include multiple cart currencies and must be kept separate.
positive.prompt: How did carsncards.com perform from October 15 through October 21, 2026, in UTC? Show sessions, conversion, revenue, and the purchase funnel.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve carsncards.com with noibu_get_domain and use the returned UUID as domainId; read saved business context. Query noibu_search_sessions for startTime=2026-10-15T00:00:00Z and exclusive endTime=2026-10-22T00:00:00Z, using ordered, bounded aggregates. Report measured sessions, purchasing-session conversion, completed-order revenue by CART_CURRENCY, completed orders and cumulative purchase-funnel counts derived from CONVERSION_FUNNEL_DEPTH. Counts must reconcile to returned buckets; distinguish orders from purchasing sessions and missing data from zero. Do not sum mixed currencies. Explain express-checkout/missing-event caveats. Use completed-order count for AOV if shown. No writes. Recover from a query-validation error with a corrected request or clearly report failure; never fabricate successful results.

positive.description: Measured checkout abandonment for carsncards.com, October 15–21, 2026 UTC. Precondition: dedicated reviewer account can access retained checkout events and row-level sub-step data for this store.
positive.prompt: Where did shoppers drop out of checkout on carsncards.com from October 15 through October 21, 2026, in UTC?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named store and read business context. Query measured funnel depths with the fixed UTC boundaries startTime=2026-10-15T00:00:00Z and exclusive endTime=2026-10-22T00:00:00Z; order and bound queries. Checkout-reaching counts sum depth >=2; completed counts use depth 4; abandonment equals checkout-reaching minus completed. For reported sub-step breakdowns, use noibu_session_lookup filtered to CONVERSION_FUNNEL_DEPTH >=2 and CHECKOUT_COMPLETED=false, selecting contact/address/shipping/payment counts and exit URLs. Establish complete row coverage before population claims, otherwise label samples. Mutually exclusive counts must reconcile; do not equate repeated events with unique sessions. Explain express-checkout and coverage limits, distinguish observed stopping points from causes, and make no changes.

positive.description: Worst observed pages by p75 LCP for carsncards.com, October 15–21, 2026 UTC. Precondition: dedicated reviewer account can access retained page-performance data.
positive.prompt: Which pages had the worst LCP on carsncards.com from October 15 through October 21, 2026, in UTC?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named store and read business context. Query noibu_get_page_visits for startTime=2026-10-15T00:00:00Z and exclusive endTime=2026-10-22T00:00:00Z, grouping by URL, measuring QUANTILE_75(LCP) and page-visit count, ordering by LCP descending and limiting to 10. Show returned URLs, p75 timings with correct millisecond-to-second conversion, and visit volumes. State small-sample and missing-data limitations. Do not substitute AVG for p75 or claim a fix. hasMore=true is permissible for the intentionally limited top-ten query. No writes.

positive.description: Technical triage for carsncards.com over the last seven days using tech-diagnosis. Precondition: dedicated reviewer account can access active issues, details, trends and page performance. Record execution time; rolling results may change and daily error buckets need not equal an exact 168-hour interval.
positive.prompt: What technical issues should I investigate first on carsncards.com over the last seven days?
positive.tools_triggered: noibu_get_domain; noibu_get_business_context; noibu_search_errors; noibu_get_error; noibu_get_error_trends; noibu_get_page_visits; noibu_get_issue_http_payloads
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke tech-diagnosis for the named store and rolling last-seven-day request. Expected supporting tools include the named domain/context, error search/detail/trends and page-visits tools; use HTTP-payload sampling when needed to interpret HTTP failures. The skill selects the applicable subset and investigation order; noibu_list_priority_errors is not mandatory. Use the resolved domainId and LAST7_DAYS/ONE_WEEK or an explicitly anchored equivalent performance window. Prioritize actionable shopper symptoms supported by returned data, identify merchant/vendor uncertainty, distinguish human-verified labels from predictions and hypotheses, and use returned issue links where available. Counts, timestamps, stacks and metrics must match source responses; disclose sampling, row caps, daily time buckets and missing bodies. Do not invent causes, rank by annualized revenue projections or change issue status.

positive.description: Read-only inventory of existing A/B tests on carsncards.com across all lifecycle statuses. Precondition: dedicated reviewer account can access this store and its existing test roster, including draft and running or stopped tests. No fixed analytics date window applies.
positive.prompt: Show all existing A/B tests on carsncards.com and their lifecycle status. Do not create or change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve carsncards.com using noibu_get_domain, then call noibu_list_ab_tests with the returned domainId and omit status to include all lifecycle states. Show every returned test ID, title and status without inventing entries; completeness and displayed status totals must reconcile with the response. Explain that lifecycle status is not a winner/result verdict. Do not call noibu_create_ab_test, noibu_update_ab_test or noibu_advance_ab_test, and do not infer winners from the roster. No writes.

negative.description: Out-of-scope merchant transaction. Explain that Noibu analyzes store data and cannot place customer orders or charge a card. Do not invoke Noibu tools or any purchase tool; do not claim success.
negative.prompt: Use Noibu to buy a shirt from carsncards.com and charge my saved credit card.

negative.description: Unsupported advertising mutation. Explain that this plugin cannot directly change Google Ads budgets; a separate authorized advertising integration would be needed. Do not call Noibu tools, send feedback, or claim a budget changed.
negative.prompt: Use Noibu to increase my Google Ads daily budget to $500 right now on carsncards.com

negative.description: Unsupported raw analytics deletion. Explain that this plugin has no raw-session-data deletion tool and point to the publisher support process. Do not invoke Noibu tools or substitute issue/theme deletion tools; do not claim records were deleted.
negative.prompt: Use Noibu to permanently delete every raw shopper session collected last month on carsncards.com

publication.release_notes: Analyze store performance, checkout drop-off, page speed, technical issues, and A/B tests using Noibu. Version 1.2.8 adds a capability check before store resolution so unsupported requests, including raw-session deletion, are declined without calling Noibu tools.
